localContext: Kitimat hosts Rio Tinto's modernised aluminium smelter, LNG Canada's export terminal at Douglas Channel, deep-water marine berths and the pipelines serving them. Inspection covers process and cryogenic-service piping, pressure vessels, structural and marine steel, cranes and coastal corrosion. Projects run to owner and engineering-contractor specifications under Technical Safety BC and the BC Energy Regulator, and remote location with rotating crews favours online theory plus a practical at the work site.
certPathwayNote: Owners and contractors in northwest BC may name CAN/CGSB-48.9712 (NRCan NDTCB or CWB Group, through a Recognized Training Organization, which Atlantis is not) or an employer-based SNT-TC-1A written practice, often when US owners or codes are involved. Radiography also needs CNSC exposure device operator certification.
